title: Compatible bounded stalk presentations of stabilized images
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, I a quasi-coherent ideal and alpha:F -> H a map of coherent formal modules [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let c be a stabilization bound for images of ker(alpha_l) in F_m for l >= m+c. Let S be an inverse system with a natural transformation j:S -> F whose components identify S_m with these stabilized images. There is b such that, for every x in X and every germ-compatible identification of the unit stalk with O_(X,x), there is an O_(X,x)-module M and compatible surjective linear maps p_m:M -> (S_m)_x, satisfying ker p_(n+d) contained in J^(n+1) M for all n and all d >= max(c,b), where J is the stalk image of I [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. Compatibility means (S_b -> S_a)_x p_b = p_a for every a <= b. No finite-generation assertion over O_(X,x) is made.

source.place: Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), affine calculation for claims (a)--(c); source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087X

proof.text: For each affine U use the exact affine stalk filtration model: one finite module N over the completed ring R, a submodule L, compatible surjections p_m on each stalk, and an order homomorphism phi carrying ideal powers of L to stalk ideal powers and intersection filtrations to the kernels of p_m. This supplies no bound.

The affine coordinate ring is Noetherian, as is its adic completion. Apply Artin-Rees to L inside N to obtain b_U. For d>=b_U, Artin-Rees rewrites K^(n+d+1)N intersect L as K^(n+d+1-b_U)(K^b_U N intersect L), contained in K^(n+1)L. Map along the injective subtype of L to obtain the same containment inside L. Monotonicity of phi and its ideal-power equation give ker(p_(n+d)) <= J^(n+1)M. The Lean private helper proves this containment for all n and d.

Compactness of the Noetherian scheme gives a finite affine subcover. Set b to the supremum of the b_U over this finite set. For each x choose a member containing x, use its presentation, and observe b_U<=b<=max(c,b)<=d. The local containment applies for every n and d. The empty finite set has supremum zero and no points require a presentation.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 087X: exact affine intersection model, Mathlib Artin-Rees containment, finite affine-cover supremum

theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_stalk_presentation
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H)
    (c : ℕ) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj)
    (hc : ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l),
      Subobject.mk
          (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) =
        Subobject.mk
          (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op)))
    (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅
      Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op),
      e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m)) :
    ∃ b : ℕ, ∀ x : X,
      ∀ e : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≅
          ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x),
      (∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (r : Γ(X, U)),
        e.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf
          U x hx r) = X.presheaf.germ U x hx r) →
      let T := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x
      let J : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := LinearMap.range (T.map I.toModulesι ≫ e.hom).hom
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x),
        ∃ p : ∀ m : ℕ, M →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x] T.obj (S.obj (op m)),
          (∀ m : ℕ, Function.Surjective (p m)) ∧
          (∀ (a b : ℕ) (h : a ≤ b) (z : M),
            (T.map (S.map (homOfLE h).op)).hom (p b z) = p a z) ∧
          (∀ (d : ℕ), max c b ≤ d → ∀ n : ℕ,
            LinearMap.ker (p (n + d)) ≤
              J ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule (X.presheaf.stalk x) M))
